facts.product: sonicdesk — a web workspace for bands ("version control for music"). This campaign promotes the Snippet feature: inside a song's mixer you select a 5–30 second part of the mix (presets 5/10/15/20/25/30 s or free drag), it snaps to section starts (Verse, Chorus, etc.), loops for listening, and exports as an audio file you can use to test the hook in Reels/TikTok before release.
facts.immutables: sonicdesk logo and wordmark ("sonicdesk." with a lime dot), brand colours (lime #DFFF00 on near-black #060805), typefaces (Archivo for headlines, JetBrains Mono for body), the look of the product UI (square corners, thin hairline borders, pill-shaped waveforms), and the feature behaviour described in the claims.

sonicdesk.

sonicdesk

sonicdesk.

a workspace where a band keeps its songs: every take lossless, every version kept, comments on the exact bars.

Direct, never decorative. Built by musicians, for musicians. Mechanical-confident, like good studio gear. Specific — bars, takes, versions, not "items". Waveforms a drawn as pills, never rectangles: full-round bars with a 2px gap (3px on phones), height from the audio peaks with a 14–15% floor. Unplayed pills are the track colour (or `foreground`) at 15–25%; played pills turn `lime`. The playhead is a 1px `lime` line with a soft glow (`shadow-playhead`) and a small triangle on the ruler.

Hover-revealed controls exist only on devices with a real pointer (`can-hover`); on touch they are always shown.
